title: Access Pad
description: A simple mod that adds a pad to let you open your benches (chests, furnaces, and blocks from any mod) anywhere in any dimension!
body:
# Access Pad

Have you ever put your items in a chest at your base, walked far away, and then realized you forgot something? This mod fixes that! It adds a cool Access Pad item that lets you link to your storage or machines and open them from anywhere.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/IngmCCNy16w" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

### What it does:

*   **Open blocks from anywhere** just by clicking the pad in your main hand or offhand.
*   **3 Tiers** of pads that you can craft and upgrade.

### ![Access Pad tier 1 recepie (within 16 blocks)](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_74a8b3b6-4367-4d4d-ad4d-28d15a2c23e1.png)

Access Pad tier 1 recepie (within 16 blocks)

 

![Access Pad tier 2 recepie (within 64 blocks)](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_9da5192c-1b0d-4494-8744-e7a6a148d9d0.png)

Access Pad tier 2 recepie (within 64 blocks)

![Access Pad tier 3 recepie (any where in any dimension)](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_11bb9a1d-d616-4e8c-93c1-5c045b0309e6.png)

Access Pad tier 3 recepie (any where in any dimension)

 

### Uses:

*   Chests and Trapped Chests (works perfectly on double chests too!)
*   Barrels
*   Furnaces, Blast Furnaces, and Smokers
*   Brewing Stands
*   Crafters
*   It basically works on almost every bench in Minecraft, and even machines from other mods!
*   **Works in other dimensions**

### How to use:

1.  Craft the Access Pad.
2.  Sneak + Right-Click on the chest or machine you want to link it to.
3.  Walk away, and Right-Click the pad to open the menu from anywhere!

 

## Attention:

You will need to load the chunks for the benches so you will need a chunk loader, we recommend FTB chunk loader.
